comment: Identity rebrand for the openobserve-ci fork (fork of DataDog/datadog-ci, stripped to symbol-upload commands). TypeScript monorepo: the 'namespace' is the npm scope @datadog/*, not Java-style package dirs, so this is content-heavy with one pathRename (the published-bin package dir) + fileRenames. PHASE A = identity only. The FUNCTIONAL Datadog intake (datadoghq.com hosts, DD_SITE/DD_API_KEY auth against Datadog's sourcemap API) is NOT rewritten here — Phase B repoints uploads to OpenObserve /api/{org}/sourcemaps (patches/, real adapter). Reuses the Android fork rebrand.mjs. Run to fixpoint with --check.

fileRenames.why: files whose basename carries the tool name (datadog-ci.ts, .datadog-ci.json fixtures)
class-name files (DatadogCiConfig.ts, ...) after content rules rename the symbol inside

rules.why: the core package name imported across the monorepo (318 refs). Most-specific first.
de-brand residual references to the removed plugin packages (in tooling/tests/docs) so no @datadog token survives
the bin name + bare tool references + .datadog-ci.json config file (after all @datadog/datadog-ci* rules so those win first)
catch-all for remaining mixed-case Datadog substring (prose, user-agent, product name). After the compound rule.
env-var NAME prefixes (DD_API_KEY, DD_SITE, DD_SUBDOMAIN, ...). \b guards ADD_/ODD_. VALUES/auth behavior are Phase B.
lowercase camelCase identifiers. Word-boundary guarded so it never matches datadoghq/ x-datadog wire strings.

intentionallyNotRebranded.comment: PHASE B — functional Datadog->OpenObserve intake adapter (patches/), not a string swap.
items: datadoghq.com / datadoghq.eu / DD_SITE host VALUES (291 refs): the upload host + the base-intake-url helper. Phase B replaces the site->host logic with an OpenObserve endpoint config.
the Datadog sourcemap/dsym intake API shape + auth (DD_API_KEY): Phase B adapts uploads to OpenObserve /api/{org}/sourcemaps with the org token (doc 06 §2/§4).
dangling references to the removed plugin packages in bin/ tooling, e2e, and docs: cleaned during build-verify (yarn install + tsc surfaces them); not identity-critical.
keep-ours identity files (README, LICENSE/NOTICE, .github) + CHANGELOG reset.
